page.overview:
Who is Ysbaddaden?

Ysbaddaden, is a fictional extraterrestrial being created by American author Kevin L. O'Brien for his short Cthulhu Mythos story "October Surprise".

According to The Book of Merlin, Ysbaddaden and its sibling Scathach were the offspring of Hzioulquoigmnzhah and Klosmiebhyx on distant Yuggoth. When the cannibalistic Cxaxukluth came in search of nourishment, Ysbaddaden and Scathach were whisked off to Cykranosh by Hzioulquoigmnzhah. What became if it afterwards is not recorded (: "October Surprise").

Ysbaddaden, Chief of Giants is the name of a character from Welsh mythology which is loosely related to the legend of King Arthur. According to the folklore, Ysbaddaden was killed by a nobleman named Goreu after it killed many of his siblings.
